name: 双语阅读 · Bilingual Reading
description: 3 chapters from The Wind in the Willows (Kenneth Grahame), English original with Chinese translation. Companion web tool renders long-form reading cards with an in-card Original / Side-by-side / Translation switch; the speaker button reads the English text aloud, tapping the translation reads the Chinese. 3 章《柳林风声》节选（英文原文 + 中文译文）；配套小工具提供长文阅读卡，卡内「原文/对照/译文」三段切换，喇叭键读英文原文，点译文读中文。
author: Alfred Long
